name: Champion
notes: Improved Critical: weapon and Unarmed Strike critical hits on 19–20.
Remarkable Athlete: advantage on Initiative and Strength (Athletics); after a critical hit, move up to half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Evoker
notes: Evocation Savant: add two level 1–2 Wizard Evocation spells to your spellbook.
Potent Cantrip: a damaging cantrip deals half damage on a miss or successful save, with no additional effect.

name: Dragonborn
notes: Breath Weapon: replace an attack with a 15-foot cone or 30-foot by 5-foot line; Dexterity save for half of 1d10 ancestry damage; uses equal to proficiency per Long Rest.
Resistance to ancestry damage.

name: Dwarf
notes: Dwarven Resilience: Poison resistance and advantage on saves against the Poisoned condition.
Dwarven Toughness: +1 maximum HP per level.
Stonecunning: bonus action for 60-foot Tremorsense on stone, 10 minutes, proficiency uses per Long Rest.

name: Elf
notes: Fey Ancestry: advantage on saves against the Charmed condition.
Trance: no sleep required, immune to magical sleep; four-hour conscious trance completes a Long Rest.
Keen Senses: proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

name: Gnome
notes: Gnomish Cunning: advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

name: Goliath
notes: Powerful Build: advantage on checks to end Grappled; count as one size larger for carrying capacity.
Giant Ancestry: proficiency uses of the selected trait per Long Rest.

name: Halfling
notes: Brave: advantage on saves against Frightened.
Halfling Nimbleness: move through spaces of larger creatures.
Luck: reroll a natural 1 on a D20 Test; use the new result.
Naturally Stealthy: may Hide while obscured by a creature at least one size larger.

name: Human
notes: Resourceful: gain Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest.
Skillful: one extra skill proficiency.
Versatile: one additional Origin feat.

name: Orc
notes: Adrenaline Rush: bonus action Dash grants temporary HP equal to proficiency; proficiency uses per Short or Long Rest.
Relentless Endurance: once per Long Rest, drop to 1 HP instead of 0 unless killed outright.

name: Tiefling
notes: Otherworldly Presence: Thaumaturgy cantrip.
Fiendish Legacy provides resistance and spells.

name: Rock Gnome
notes: Tinker: ten-minute Prestidigitation creates a Tiny device (AC 5, HP 1), at most three, lasting eight hours; touch and bonus action activate the selected spell effect.

name: Cloud Giant
notes: Bonus action: teleport up to 30 feet to a visible unoccupied space.

name: Fire Giant
notes: After hitting and damaging a target, deal an additional 1d10 Fire damage.

name: Frost Giant
notes: After hitting and damaging a target, deal 1d6 Cold damage and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until your next turn.

name: Hill Giant
notes: After hitting and damaging a Large or smaller target, knock it Prone.

name: Stone Giant
notes: Reaction when damaged: reduce damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier.

name: Storm Giant
notes: Reaction when damaged by a creature within 60 feet: deal 1d8 Thunder damage to it.

name: Alert
notes: Add proficiency to Initiative; may exchange Initiative with a willing ally if neither is Incapacitated.

name: Savage Attacker
notes: Once per turn on a weapon hit, roll weapon damage dice twice and use either result.

name: Skilled
notes: Gain proficiency in three skills or tools.

name: Archery
notes: +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

name: Defense
notes: +1 AC while wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor.

name: Great Weapon Fighting
notes: On damage dice for two-handed attacks with a Two-Handed or Versatile Melee weapon, treat rolls of 1 or 2 as 3.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
notes: Add the ability modifier to damage for the extra attack granted by the Light property.

name: Magic Initiate Cleric
notes: Learn two cantrips and prepare one level 1 spell from the selected list; choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. One free cast of the level 1 spell per Long Rest; spell slots may also be used.

name: Magic Initiate Druid
notes: Learn two cantrips and prepare one level 1 spell from the selected list; choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. One free cast of the level 1 spell per Long Rest; spell slots may also be used.

name: Magic Initiate Wizard
notes: Learn two cantrips and prepare one level 1 spell from the selected list; choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. One free cast of the level 1 spell per Long Rest; spell slots may also be used.
